description.p: NewScid is a Scid v4 database-compatible chess application written in Go (Wails v2) and Vue 3 (TypeScript).

ul.li: Native binary reading and writing for Scid .si4, .sn4, and .sg4 databases
Position, header, material, and pattern search across Huffman-compressed games
PGN parsing and export with NAGs, commentary, and variations
Opening Tree Explorer with move statistics and Polyglot book support
UCI chess engine analysis with evaluation graphs and blunder detection
Opening repertoire trainer with spaced-repetition scheduling
Tactical puzzle drills and database puzzle extraction
Customizable chessboard themes and 17 vector piece sets

description.p: Initial release of NewScid with full Scid database support and modern UI.
